parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program

ns2:course.label: Seminar
ns2:course.description: Special topics in agricultural leadership, education or communications. Same as AGCM 499. 1 to 4 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in the same or separate semesters, if topics vary. Prerequisite: ALEC Program approval required.
